prompt: Which Vietnamese professor explained the mysterious case of two monks said to have been meditating for over 400 years, as shown in a YouTube video posted on April 4, 2023?
answer: The case was explained by **Professor Nguyễn Lân Cường**, a Vietnamese archaeologist and anthropologist who researched and helped restore the preserved remains of the monks Vũ Khắc Minh and Vũ Khắc Trường at Đậu Pagoda.
